column51: "Practice GPS06 circling06 at n26n, Bradley Schmidt, PA28 proficiency training "

column44: "Practiced comm maneuvers.  Lazy 8s, steep spirals, Chandelles, steep turns, 8s on pylons, and landings. Good job on all. The map shows it. Just remember to pull back on yoke when making left turn in steep turns. "

"Good job today.  Practiced 8s on pylons.  Have to bring the left turn in a bit, but otherwise sharp.  Steep spirals improved.  Chandelles. Good. Slow flight good.  Stalls. Power off get into a stabilized descent before starting the procedure, same for power On.  Stabilize at 70kts then perform the maneuver "

"Another good day.  Landings on point. Short field T/L, soft field T/L, Normal T/L. All excellent.  Practiced steep turns, remember to keep head up instead of inside looking at instruments.  Lazy 8s, good. Chandelles good, worked on steep spirals. Overall great performance. "

"Flight to satisfy 61.129(a)(3)(iv). Instruction received on night xc operations and planning, visual illusions, traffic pattern entries, ATC flight following procedures, as well as operation of the Garmin G3X "
